caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates performance comparisons across four different prompts (V1, V2, V3, and V4) of the Humor Detection Model (HDM) based on a GEMBA-SQM score. The horizontal axis displays the prompt labels: V1, V2, V3, and V4, arranged in left-to-right order. The vertical axis represents the GEMBA-SQM score, ranging from 97.7 to 99.2 with a linear scale. The score axis is labeled "Fluency" and features tick marks with an interval of 0.15, indicating a precision of 0.15. The bar corresponding to V1 is a dark blue color and reaches a height of approximately 98.5, while the bar for V2 is orange and reaches a height of approximately 98.2. The bar representing V3 is a light green and reaches a height of approximately 98.0, and the bar for V4 is a pale purple and reaches a height of approximately 97.7. All bars are uniformly spaced and there are no visual elements used to emphasize any particular bar.
